integrity: Proof and reproducibility checker are supplied in full. Direct enumeration is finite corroboration, not the infinite proof. The day-verified source date refers to the 2015 public archival source used for this research, not a claim that Lucas congruences first appeared in 2015.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns cyclic blocks and the quadratic character modulo seven, not full Apéry residue classes, higher powers of seven or unwrapped cross-boundary correlations. General digit-correlation theory leaves residual implicit-priority risk; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp cyclic quadratic-character correlations of Apéry numbers modulo seven
